steps.prompt: Before the check: which part of a paragraph (topic, evidence, explanation, transitions, closing) do you feel best at? Which needs more work?
steps.placeholder: I’m best at… I need more work on…

cards.title: Paragraphs: quick review
cards.body: Topic sentence: one clear main idea. Evidence: facts, examples or quotes. Explanation: what each piece of evidence shows. Transitions: signposts between ideas. Closing sentence: the main idea in new words.

cards.title: Two paragraphs, two ideas
cards.body: When you write two paragraphs, give each one its own main idea (for example, two different reasons). Press Enter to start the second paragraph, and open it with a transition like “In addition,” or “Another reason…”.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First, a 10-question quiz: you need 8 right (80%) to pass. If you don’t pass, you’ll see which skills to review, and you’ll get new questions next time. Then you’ll write a two-paragraph response. Quill gives it a score.

prompts: Look at your paragraph map. Does each paragraph have all four parts?
What will you check in every paragraph you write from now on?
